title: Quantitative assessment of PV modules affected by Type-C cracks using electroluminescence imaging
mechanism: Automatic crack segmentation plus Type-C power-loss quantification across 100 field modules; power loss follows a GEV distribution.
adaptation: Prior for power-loss band edges (for example <5%, 5 to 20%, >20%) in the severity confusion matrix.
evidence: R: 100 modules after 11 years; mean estimated loss 12.77%; modules > 20% loss unlikely.
